input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including result, user. The platform provides capabilities for token, token, exceptions handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage result records, so that I can track and organize result data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to use exceptions handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use my meta object handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
